description: A React component named DeploymentsOverTime that renders a responsive area chart displaying deployment counts over selectable time ranges. It fetches deployment data from an API, processes it for visualization, and provides UI controls for range selection.

methods.name: withAlpha
methods.description: Converts a hex color to an rgba string with specified alpha transparency.

methods.name: toLocalDateString
methods.description: Converts a date string or object to a 'YYYY-MM-DD' formatted string.

methods.name: applyTimeRange
methods.description: Filters deployment items based on the selected time range.
